data.one_liner: A customizable and draggable Kanban Board widget for Flutter supporting multi-groups.
data.what_it_does: AppFlowyBoard provides a board-style widget consisting of multi-groups with full drag-and-drop support between and within groups. It allows developers to create Trello-like Kanban boards with custom cards, headers, footers, and controllers to track changes.
use_when: You need to build a Kanban board or task management interface in Flutter.
Users need to drag and drop cards between different columns or reorder items inside groups.
avoid_when: You need a standard grid or list view without multi-group Kanban functionality.
You require complex state management solutions that do not fit a controller-based board pattern.
strengths: Supports drag and drop between different groups and within the same group.
Highly customizable with builders for headers, footers, and cards.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside of the basic README and example files.
Niche widget targeted specifically at Kanban board layouts.
